description: Eval multimodal chat (live model-comparison eval): create a 2-10 model session (LIVE chats real models; OFFLINE annotates an imported conversation), send user turns that every configured model answers, record frozen-contract verdicts (RANKING per turn; STEP_REASONING/FACT_CHECK per model message; CLASSIFICATION named fields per message or conversation), read the full transcript, compute win-rate/variance/position-bias analytics, and close the session. Turn conflicts (stale expectedTurn, in-flight fan-out, caps) are retryable 409s. Export DPO pages ({prompt, chosen, rejected, info} pairwise lines) with cursor/limit until nextCursor is null. Requires open-label:read for get/list/analytics/export, open-label:write otherwise, plus the project capability matrix.
name: open_label_eval_chat
